signal: Dealerslink launched its 2026 AI Suite, the industry's first fully integrated AI inventory platform, and set a booth attendance record at NADA 2026

email.body1:
Brad, saw Dealerslink launched its 2026 AI Suite and set a booth record at NADA with 1,400-plus dealers.

Demand at that level usually puts more dealers in play than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Dealerslink off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brad, quick follow-up for Dealerslink.

After a launch and a record NADA, the regional target usually outruns headcount. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Brad, last bit of proof for Dealerslink.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Dealerslink's reply rate likely compares to other automotive software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brad, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Following up on a record NADA is its own kind of busy, and I get it.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your region? I will tailor it to Dealerslink either way.
